images.caption: Storm Surge Inundation Map
images.details: Interactive GIS map displaying storm surge inundation depth for a 25-year return period. The OpenLayers-based viewer overlays hazard data on OpenStreetMap with fill-in percentage indicators, enabling planners to assess flood risk at proposed infrastructure sites.

images.caption: Land Use Classification Table

images.caption: Delta Hotspot Climate Screening

images.caption: Climate Screening Questionnaire

images.caption: Analysis Loading State

images.caption: Multi-Layer GIS Analysis Engine

The main map displays Delta Hotspot zones with a comprehensive legend showing land use categories.

images.caption: KML File Upload Interface

images.caption: User Profile Details

images.caption: Questionnaire File Import
